title: Nyakati na hali. (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na uhalifu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads the time word and gives the verb the matching marker: -li- past, -na- now, -ta- future.
representations: a verb with its marker coloured

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Jana nilisoma" and the same with leo and kesho.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Jana, Juma a___soma kitabu." Kwa nini "na" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wakati uliopita unatumia -li-: jana alisoma. Uliopo -na-: sasa anasoma. Ujao -ta-: kesho atasoma.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kesho, Wanjiru a___soma kitabu." Kwa nini "li" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: -li- ni kwa yaliyotokea. -ta- ni kwa yatakayotokea.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua kitenzi: Jana sisi ___ kwa basi." Kwa nini "walisafiri" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi kinahitaji nafsi na wakati: sisi tulisafiri, wao walisafiri, mimi nilisafiri.

misconceptions.ask: Neno gani linaonyesha wakati katika sentensi hii?
